title: Lasso & Free Transform enhancements
description: Lasso tool (L): freeform drag selection, Polygon Mode for straight-edged, Magic Wand for bitmap regions. Free Transform enhancements: Distort mode (drag corner to skew), Envelope mode (9-point mesh warp). PolyStar tool: polygon/star shapes with configurable sides/points. See docs/04-toolbox.md.
